text:
maria: heads up — Competitor Z just announced a ~10x cheaper embeddings offering claiming parity on our benchmarks. saw the press email this morning. :thinking:
raj: saw traffic shift in the last 6 hours from a couple of small accounts, flagged in churn mentions. not huge but pattern is worrying.
olivia: ran quick A/B on our Embed-v2 vs their demo on 3 customer datasets: avg cosine delta ~0.018 for top-10, recall drop around 1.6% on search sets but latency and cost differ. i can share the notebook later.
taylor: thanks — this is primarily a pricing/playbook competitor. product questions: do we (A) match price with a lower-cost quantized model + routing, (B) bundle cheaper embeddings as a limited "lite" tier, or (C) lean on quality/differentiation and double-down on tooling/analytics?
ben: engineering constraints: cheap quantized inference needs new inference image and batching changes, plus separate autoscale pool to keep latency SLOs. estimate 3-4 sprints to production for decent throughput.
dina (sales): front-line asks from trials: customers want predictable per-embedding pricing and a small "budget" option they can try. several prospects asked if we have a low-cost embedding for indexing cold data.
maria: need concrete launch criteria before we commit cycles. proposal: for any "lite" offering we require: 1) precision@10 gap <= 2% vs default, 2) 95th latency < 120ms, 3) unit cost <= $0.0008 per 768-d embedding, 4) monitorable quality regressions and automatic rollback window. thoughts?
olivia: those criteria look reasonable. i can prepare a holdout prompt set and compute precision/recall deltas. recommend adding a synthetic adversarial shard to catch edge-case regressions.
raj: can we also add a traffic-based canary plan? start at 1% traffic, measure query-quality signal & product metrics for 48h, then 10%, 25%. include auto-fallback to default model if degradation > threshold.
taylor: we should also define GTM constraints: limited to hosted API only for now, not Dedicated or Private until we validate. also pricing skews: offer "lite" as non-SLA tier and opt-out by enterprise.
ben: ops note: separate routing policy and a lightweight cache policy for lite because small embeddings change cache hit patterns. will need metrics on tokenization cost too.
maria: ok action items: olivia — produce scoreboard + adversarial shard by EOD Fri; ben & raj — feasibility and rough infra timeline by Tue; taylor — draft pricing & GTM pitch for sales by Wed; dina — collect top 5 customer asks and pricing thresholds. i'll sync with eng leads Wed 11am. :thumbsup:
dina (sales): i'll ping top trial leads and share thresholds in the doc.
raj: one more ask — include a rollback SLA: if customer experiences >5% drop in retrieval success for 1 hour, auto-disable lite for that tenant. we can enforce via route policy.
olivia: ack, will include metric hooks for that.
maria: thanks team. if anyone sees competitor technical docs or benchmarks, drop them here. deploy-bot: new canary resources request pending approval for 2 GPU nodes :information_source:
